quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #18
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: You must stop at an intersection when you see a:
questions.correctAnswerText: Flashing red light.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same thing as a stop sign. You must stop completely, look both ways, and only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do when you enter a roadway from a private road?

options.text: Blow your horn to warn cars you are entering the roadway.
Stop with part of your car on the roadway to alert other drivers.
Drive out fast to merge smoothly with the traffic.
Yield the right-of-way to pedestrians and roadway traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield the right-of-way to pedestrians and roadway traffic.
questions.explanation: When entering a roadway from a driveway or private road, you must give the right-of-way to pedestrians and traffic already on the roadway.

questions.question: Double solid yellow lines painted down the middle of the road mean:

options.text: Passing is not permitted from either direction.
Passing is permitted from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not permitted from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot pass from either direction. You may only cross these lines to turn left or pass pedestrians, bicyclists, or scooter riders when it is safe and the opposite lane is clear.

questions.question: What kinds of drugs can affect your driving ability?
questions.correctAnswerText: All of these choices
questions.explanation: Many drugs can affect your driving, including illegal drugs and over-the-counter or prescription medicines. Driving while impaired by any drug is illegal.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Merging traffic from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is entering the roadway from the right.

questions.question: When faced with an oncoming car to the left and a bicyclist to the right, you should:

options.text: Let the car pass and then pass the bike.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the car pass and then pass the bike.
questions.explanation: When you have multiple hazards, handle one at a time. Let the oncoming car pass first, then pass the bicyclist. Do not try to pass both at the same time.

questions.question: Which of the following must you obey over the other three?
questions.correctAnswerText: A police officer
questions.explanation: A police officer's directions always come before signs, signals, and road markings. Other people who can direct traffic include fire police, road work flaggers, and school crossing guards.

questions.question: Motorcycles are entitled to:

options.text: The same full lane width as other motor vehicles.
Half the width of a lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same full lane width as other motor vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have the right to use the full width of a lane, just like any other vehicle.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Crossroad ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you about an intersection ahead.

questions.question: While driving on a two-lane road without bicycle lanes, you encounter a bicyclist traveling in the same direction. What is the safest way to pass the bicyclist?

options.text: Slow down and wait until there is no traffic approaching, then pass the bicyclist while leaving him or her sufficient space.
Continue driving straight. It is the bicyclist's responsibility to get out of your way.
Do not pass the bicyclist until you come to a traffic signal or stop sign.
Honk at the bicyclist to let him or her know you are about to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and wait until there is no traffic approaching, then pass the bicyclist while leaving him or her sufficient space.
questions.explanation: Pass a bicyclist the same way you pass any other vehicle. Leave at least 3 feet of space between your mirror and the bicyclist, or 5 feet on faster roads or with groups of bicyclists. Do not honk, as it may startle the rider and cause a crash.

questions.question: You must change your speed based on:
questions.correctAnswerText: All of these.
questions.explanation: You must slow down when conditions are not ideal. This includes bad road surfaces, bad weather, time of day, narrow roads, or heavy traffic.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Cars turning left on green must let oncoming traffic pass first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cars turning left on green must let oncoming traffic pass first.
questions.explanation: This sign works with traffic lights. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to pass. Left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: A driver entering an interstate from a ramp should:

options.text: Let drivers already on the interstate go first.
Can force their way into traffic.
Can assume other drivers will move for them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let drivers already on the interstate go first.
questions.explanation: When you enter an interstate from a ramp, you must let drivers already on the highway pass first. Merge safely when you have space.

questions.question: What does a single dashed yellow line between lanes mean?

options.text: You may pass if it is safe.
Both lanes go the same direction.
You may pass even if it is dangerous.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines divide traffic going in opposite directions. A single dashed yellow line means cars in both directions can pass. You may only pass if oncoming traffic is clear.

questions.question: You are legally considered to be driving under the influence at a blood alcohol level of:
questions.correctAnswerText: 0.08 percent.
questions.explanation: The legal limit is 0.08 percent blood alcohol. Driving with this level or higher is a crime. Driving under the influence of drugs or alcohol is dangerous.

questions.question: If your wheels leave the road and go onto the shoulder, you should:

options.text: Brake hard and turn sharply back onto the road.
Slow down and carefully steer back onto the road.
Keep your speed and turn sharply back onto the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and carefully steer back onto the road.
questions.explanation: If your wheels drop onto the shoulder, reduce your speed without hard braking. Carefully steer back onto the road. Watch for other cars when you return to the road.

questions.question: Parking lights may only be used:

options.text: Within one hour after sunset or before sunrise.
When driving below the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: When your car is parked.
questions.explanation: Use parking lights only when your car is parked. Do not use them when driving.

questions.question: If your power steering stops working while driving, you should:

options.text: Honk and turn off the engine.
Turn on hazard lights and get ready for impact.
Steer firmly, slow down, and drive to a safe place to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer firmly, slow down, and drive to a safe place to stop.
questions.explanation: Without power steering, you will need to use more force to steer. Reduce your speed and carefully drive to a safe spot off the road to stop.

questions.question: When you drive faster, your vision:

options.text: Makes it easier to see cars crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gets narrower.
questions.explanation: The faster you drive, the narrower your vision becomes. As speed increases, you see less to the sides. You must pay extra attention to dangers around you.

questions.question: When a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line divide the road, and the broken line is next to you, you may pass if:

options.text: The road is clear of oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is clear of oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: When the broken yellow line is on your side, you may pass. You can only cross the line if no oncoming cars are coming.
